theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → R.Represents C → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, approxTangentPlane n R.carrier (r • x) = approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x
